001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.content.Intent;
004import android.os.Bundle;
005import android.view.LayoutInflater;
006import android.view.View;
007import android.view.ViewGroup;
008import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
009import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
010import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult;
011import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
012import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
013import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
014import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
015import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
016import androidx.navigation.Navigation;
017import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInAccount;
018import com.google.android.material.snackbar.Snackbar;
019import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.LoginViewModel;
020import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
021import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.FragmentLoginBinding;
022
023
024/** @noinspection deprecation*/
025public class LoginFragment extends Fragment {
026
027  private FragmentLoginBinding binding;
028  private LoginViewModel viewModel;
029  private ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> launcher;
030
031  @Nullable
032  @Override
033  public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container,
034      @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
035    binding = FragmentLoginBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
036    binding.signIn.setOnClickListener((v) -> viewModel.startSignIn(launcher));
037    return binding.getRoot();
038  }
039
040  @Override
041  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
042    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
043    viewModel = new ViewModelProvider(requireActivity())
044        .get(LoginViewModel.class);
045    LifecycleOwner owner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
046    viewModel
047        .getAccount()
048        .observe(owner, this::handleAccount);
049    viewModel
050        .getSignInThrowable()
051        .observe(owner, this::handleThrowable);
052    launcher = registerForActivityResult(new StartActivityForResult(), viewModel::completeSignIn);
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public void onDestroyView() {
057    super.onDestroyView();
058  }
059
060  private void handleAccount(GoogleSignInAccount account) {
061    if (account != null) {
062      Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot())
063          .navigate(LoginFragmentDirections.navigateToHomeFragment());
064    }
065  }
066
067  private void handleThrowable(Throwable throwable) {
068    if (throwable != null) {
069      Snackbar.make(binding.getRoot(), R.string.sign_in_failure_message, Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG)
070          .show();
071    }
072  }
073
074}
